Findings.Title: Default migration gate accepted extra provider/context history identities
Findings.Reproduction: An owned database history containing every available migration plus an unknown or other-context identity passed applied.Length > 0/pending == 0 and repeat equality.
Findings.Impact: The tool could report a green migration identity gate without rejecting mixed history.
Findings.Resolution: Resolved by before-Migrate exact-prefix validation and after-Migrate complete exact-chain validation; repeat begins with exact-chain validation and preserves that set.

Findings.Title: Missing seed-mode value fell through to default migration execution
Findings.Reproduction: A final --seed-mode flag returned null from Arg and dispatched the default migration/catalog path instead of the requested seed gate.
Findings.Impact: The requested seed assertion could be skipped while the tool reported default green checks.
Findings.Resolution: Resolved by before-owner/environment/connection enum and seed-state value checks with explicit pre-database rejection scope.
